title: What happened in AI — Oct 27, 2026
intro: Agent security is the day's through-line: an internal pilot showed a suspended user's agent run still writing a file, and AgenticBench tested 25 coding agents on egress, telemetry and secrets. Several new tools respond by keeping credentials out of the agent entirely.
Elsewhere, Oracle plans Cerebras inference on OCI, and Moonshot apologised for a botched Kimi K3.1 Pro launch.
highlights: Agent permission checks at request time miss tool calls made after suspension.
AgenticBench scored 25 coding agents on egress, telemetry and secret handling.
Atuin Threads and Cindy let sessions and harnesses move between Claude Code and Codex.
Search-API, extraction and agent-traffic benchmarks push teams to measure their own workloads.
Oracle plans Cerebras inference on OCI; SageMaker adds SOCI-indexed images.
Moonshot apologised for the Kimi K3.1 Pro launch; Qwen requests were found routed via Alibaba servers.

categories.name: Agent permissions and credential boundaries
categories.summary: Agents keep acting after the access check passes, and today's items show teams moving secrets and scope enforcement out of the agent's reach.

articles.title: A suspended user's agent run still wrote a file: an internal pilot
